# Example Ceramics

> Independent retailer of hand-thrown stoneware tableware, shipping from Berlin to the EU and UK.

## Catalog

- [Product feed](https://ceramics.example/feed/products.xml): Google-format XML, refreshed hourly
- [Store API](https://ceramics.example/wp-json/wc/store/v1/products): JSON, live price and stock
- [Product sitemap](https://ceramics.example/wp-sitemap-posts-product-1.xml)

## Policies

- [Shipping](https://ceramics.example/shipping/)
- [Returns](https://ceramics.example/returns/)
- [Terms](https://ceramics.example/terms/)
- [Privacy](https://ceramics.example/privacy-policy/)
